verdicts.explanation: The homepage carries real brand content (this exact headline) but no Organization/sameAs markup anywhere in its JSON-LD, so the absence is real, not a crawl artifact.
The page lists a real phone number as plain text, not as a tel: link, and has no form or mailto: either, so a visitor who reads it has nothing to click.

site_specific: Wrap the phone number '0711 400 40990' in a tel: link so mobile visitors can call directly.
Add a mailto: or contact-form link next to each customer-service heading (Hausgeräte, Elektrowerkzeuge, Smart Home, etc.) so every service area has its own clickable next step.
Add an Organization JSON-LD block to the homepage naming 'Robert Bosch GmbH', with a sameAs array listing Bosch's own official social-media and reference profiles.
Reuse the same Organization block (or link to it by @id) on the other key pages crawled, such as /kontakt and /impressum, so the entity is anchored consistently across the site.
